text:
My very first time here and will be my last. I don't have problem with staff at counter btw, just others. I came and sat on the chair in an operation room and the dentist was reading document, which i don't know what it was. The assistance told me to lay on the chair and put the sheet to cover my face, and they let me stay like that for minutes without telling me anything. During that time, the assistance picked up her call then hung up to tell the dentist that she had to go for OT somewhere else so she told the dentist to hurry start my treatment. He found a decayed tooth but no further treatment on that (i believe because the assistance need to leave soon for her OT) After finished, the staff walked in to handover medical certificate for the dentist to sign. He asked the staff which language, English or Thai and keep asking the staff so i told the assistance either will do. The dentist then talked to me and asked 'do you need this to submit to manager? Is your manager Thai or Japanese?' I said 'i will submit to insurance company, which language will be fine (in Thai is ภาษาอะไรก็ได้ค่ะ)'. Then he said 'so can i write it in Japanese?' 🙂 'Is the insurance company in Thailand? Which language you asked before?'

So he ended up writing in Thai for me. Before i left, he asked 'do you want me to write that you need sick leave' i refused and went down to the first floor and the assistance also since she need to hurried to her OT work somewhere else.

I hope you get better experience if you are planning to come here

For 990 baht, you get what you pay for: not much. I think the staff and facilities are fine, but I want to help readers set expectations.

The sign in the window promises a cleaning and x-rays. But when you sit in the chair, you learn that the x-ray is only if the doctor deems it necessary. In my case, I didn’t get an x-ray, even after inquiring.

I can’t recommend this if you’re expecting a comprehensive cleaning. The cleaning experience was awkward and comically fast — fewer than 15 minutes. He jumped from tooth to tooth in no coherent order, like a child coloring outside the lines of a coloring book with a crayon with bite marks.

I’ve probably been to two dozen different dentists in my life. This was probably among the least satisfying dental experiences I’ve had.

Two stars because the low price accurately reflects the service you’d expect for something so cheap.

This was the worst experience at a dentist in my life.
I went in to get my teeth cleaned and ended up now 5 weeks later with an abscess on my gum which is not fully healed.

The dentist took no care while cleaning my teeth and poked my gums numerous times.she was chatting with the dental assistant like she was in a coffee shop for the whole time she was cleaning my teeth and kept on poking and puncturing my gums.

i have gotten my teeth cleaned every six months for the last 20 years and never have been assaulted like this.

I'm not even sure if the person who cleaned my teeth is a dentist.

An abscess on my gum started to appear the day after and gradually grew every day. I went back to the practice after 3 days as the pain was unbearable.
I was told that it had nothing to do with the cleaning and that I had gum disease.

As I was leaving the room I heard the "dentist" and assistant laughing.
This is the most unprofessional practice I have ever been to.

After two weeks and still taking antibiotics I asked to speak to the owner
After eventually getting a hold of him he told me he fired the dentist and agreed to pay for me to see someone else in the clinic or a friend of his.

After been on antibiotics for 4 weeks and I have had my holiday ruined I asked the owner to pay compensation so I could go to another dentist.
I did not want to take his recommendation of another staff member or his offer to personally take me to another dentist as my whole experience was terrible.

After I requested compensation he refused and threatened to take me to the police station.
I have no idea what he was thinking the police were going to do about this but I politely declined and am now looking for legal advice.
If anyone has recommendations of what I can do here please let me know.

I went in for a simple teeth cleaning and now almost 5 weeks later my gum is still not fully healed.

Avoid this business if you want to stay healthy.
I had a lot of tartar buildup. Other places quoted higher prices, but here it's a flat rate of 990 baht.

The staff are lovely and friendly 😆
I was impressed by their attentiveness. The dentist was kind and gave advice on the correct way to brush my teeth and how to take care of my teeth. The clinic is clean and has a comfortable atmosphere. It's conveniently located, just 400 meters from BTS Thonglor.

The clinic is clean, the doctor is gentle, it's conveniently located near BTS Thonglor and there's a bus stop in front of the clinic. There's an interpreter available for communication, and the assistants are lovely.
I've been here twice already. The clinic is clean, the dentist is very gentle, and the staff are very polite. I will definitely come again. I highly recommend it, it's excellent!
It was my first time using the service, but I felt at ease because they spoke both English and Japanese. The clinic seemed newly opened, and the interior was nice and clean. I plan to go again.
The doctor was kind, lovely, and gentle, and the assistant was also lovely.
